query:
SELECT 
  fc.colaboradorId,
  fc.empresaSlug,
  fc.mes,
  fc.ano,
  fc.totalServicos,
  fc.totalProdutos,
  (fc.totalServicos + fc.totalProdutos) as total,
  c.nome,
  c.cashbarberProfissionalId
FROM faturamentoColaboradores fc
JOIN colaboradores c ON c.id = fc.colaboradorId
WHERE fc.colaboradorId = 22
  AND fc.mes = 3 AND fc.ano = 2026
ORDER BY fc.id DESC LIMIT 5;
